name: Almeida de Sayago (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green in the proportions two to one.
history: Almeida de Sayago has had heraldic arms and a municipal flag since 17 August 2000, when the approval of the corresponding municipal resolution, adopted unanimously by the full council on 29 July 2000, was published in the official bulletin of the province of Zamora; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two horizontal stripes in proportions 2/3 and 1/3, red above and green below.
